flatten_nested_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into dot-separated keys using flatten_dict with a separator
unflatten_dot_separated_dict: unflatten a dot-separated key dictionary back into nested structure using unflatten_dict
test_flatten_unflatten_roundtrip: test that flatten_dict and unflatten_dict are inverse operations producing the original dict
flatten_dict_non_strict_mode: flatten a dictionary with keys containing the separator by setting strict to False
unflatten_dict_custom_separator: unflatten a dictionary using a custom separator like double colon instead of dot
